results.name: Day 9 - Nintendo 64 - 3D Inktober 2019
results.description:
Fav 64 game? Mine are Zelda Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask, and Diddy Kong Racing!

This was a pain to model. The 64 has such strange geometry... But I still love it.

Modelled in Blender 2.8.
Textured in Substance Painter.

I also have a 3D blog on a Tumblr: DiscipleOfMana3D.tumblr.com
